name: tia-portal-openness-mcp
description: Siemens TIA Portal Openness automation via MCP — project/PLC/HMI scaffolding, SCL/LAD authoring, compile, download, online read. Includes runtimes for V14 SP1, V15.1, V16, V17, V18, V19, V20 and V21; the plugin selects the newest installed TIA release, then the newest runnable bundled host.
